content.author: Gary R. Habermas and Michael R. Licona (Grand Rapids: Kregel, 2004)
content.note: The 'minimal facts' method: argue only from facts that most specialists, including sceptics, grant (the crucifixion, the disciples' experiences, the conversions of Paul and James), with the empty tomb as a widely but not universally granted fact.
